_read_me_first: This is a MENU, not a config. Nothing here is switched on. Copy the servers you actually want into your own ~/.claude.json and replace every YOUR_..._HERE placeholder with your own key. Added 2026-08-23 (run-47 P6.5).
_why_it_is_a_menu: Alex's own MCP setup cannot be shipped to you: those are the author's accounts, keys and machine paths, and a committed config would be both useless to you and a credential leak for the author. So the Kit ships the SHAPE and you supply the accounts.
_keep_it_small: Every enabled server costs context in every session, whether or not you use it. Ten is a sensible ceiling. Start with none, add one when you actually need it, and remove any you stopped using - an unused server is pure overhead.
_no_keys_in_this_repo: Never paste a real key into this file or any other file in this folder. This folder is version-controlled and updates overwrite it. Keys belong in ~/.claude.json, which is yours alone and never travels.

notion._what: Read and write your Notion pages and databases.
notion._get_a_key: notion.so > Settings > Connections > develop or manage integrations

context7._what: Up-to-date documentation for libraries and frameworks. Useful if you write code; harmless otherwise.

playwright._what: Lets Alex drive a real browser for sites that have no proper API.

filesystem._what: Read and write files in ONE folder you name. Point it at a project folder, never at your whole drive.
